bubbles.title: Interview pain points
bubbles.hint: Interview the human one question at a time. Pain points so far: (1) bare ??? fog leaves the human unsure what to say, uu doesn't help much; a grill-me or research step would; (2) pre-bubble track planning to avoid premature tracks, short and not a plan-mode wall of text; (3) no guards on what to change or not to touch (target files/domains), so the agent drifts; (4) vague bubbles like 'implement new parsing method' let the agent go rogue; need better seams (not one bubble per file) that also make review easier. (3a) Guards = a ruleset of what NOT to do, to focus on the real end result; hard to write while the human is still at an unknown stage. (4a) Seams: not a one-shot across many files, and size varies (one file vs several). Split per use case, within that use case's identified boundaries. (2a) The plan's output is a better track, focused on the core end-goal problem; its guards and extra context make a stable track with fewer unknowns.

bubbles.title: E2E dev track
bubbles.hint: An e2e test (test/*.test.js, temp repo) that builds a development track by running every CLI command in turn (switch/create, add, insert, fog, type, fill, hint, handoff, rename, move, remove, fork, diverge, done, close...) and asserts each step's output. Its rendered transcript doubles as material for the flow analysis.

bubbles.title: Audit skill flow
bubbles.hint: Read SKILL.md + fallback.md + CLI; map the actual steps (sketch, classify, walk, fog stop) against the interview's pain points. For each change (plan step, guards, seams, research, grill-me), decide: reusable ability or core library/CLI feature? The human is undecided.

bubbles.title: Plan step gap
bubbles.hint: Plan up front, before the first bubble: its output is a better track focused on the core end goal. Guards (what not to do) and use-case seams fall out of the plan and are stored as hints or similar, not as separate bubbles. Also a mini-plan ability for planning later in the track when needed.

bubbles.title: Research step
bubbles.hint: Should research be a built-in step (or an ability) instead of only via known-unknown fog?

bubbles.title: Fog needs a reason
bubbles.hint: Fog is sometimes created without saying why, which irritates the user. Require a one-line reason per fog bubble (hint or CLI field).

bubbles.title: Update skill + docs
bubbles.hint: Apply the agreed changes to SKILL.md, fallback.md, README, and tests.
